important_corrections: Historical B codex_timeout groups a scene-deadline-truncated 82-second repair call with standalone approximately 300-second CLI timeouts. This review separates deadline scope without overwriting history.
Historical B outer_budget_exhausted=False does not establish spare Runtime budget: its code checks error text, while four records demonstrably exhaust the separate 600-second Runtime deadline.
H0 first-call timeouts have explicit connection-refused/network-wait events; they are not evidence that the model spent 300 seconds performing reasoning.
No failed record reached render_started. Build-time stalls are not Cycles render/GPU timeouts, and absent Boolean-start evidence is not evidence that a timeout was caused by Boolean geometry.
All ten remain original failed tasks with null measured visual quality and original separate zero utility; an engineering failure attribution does not remove the scheduled failure denominator.
